statement: The entire family of sections unramified outside three, modulo geometric conjugacy, for each of N, N/Ndoubleprime and N/gamma3(I_Q), where Q is the single rational cusp B0, has compatible explicit coordinates as the product over all degrees of coker((T_r-1)(1+J_r)). The graded modules are respectively the full free Lie lattice, the integral Chen metabelian lattice, and the Hall lattice with at most two occurrences of the marked peripheral letter. Every degree has explicit rank/trace formulas and a proven finite Smith precision bound. The actual inverse-limit map on section classes is a bijection and the chosen coordinates give a homeomorphism of pointed profinite spaces.
notes: The normalized genuine section is specified by its actual tau value x in W, with a(c)=1 and a(c tau c)=c(x). Residual conjugacy is the explicitly displayed W^c action. The completed noncommutative Magnus resolution proves the pro3 Fox identification and its (3,augmentation)-adic topology; homogeneous Koszul exactness proves the filtration equality, rather than importing a discrete Chen result without completion. Magnus expansions and integral Lazard elimination give both inclusions in the marked initial ideal. Twisted stabilizers vanish by the first nonzero weight. Fixed conjugators lift by division by two, yielding compatible Hall-zero and Smith normal forms. The output constructs degree-four matrices of ranks2475,2466,1485, traces-21,-22,-3 and coordinate free ranks1248,1244,744, and verifies exact split-lattice and Frobenius identities. The first three factors are the previously evaluated E.34/E.37/E.40 groups. This completely evaluates the unramified family; it does not claim to evaluate all ramified metabelian or marked sections. Actual maps and kernels from N to both quotients, and their common quotient, are displayed. The product is a noncanonical homeomorphism of pointed profinite spaces, not an asserted group law on sections.
